answer: One concrete defense: make every agent post a non-refundable bond to join the voting rolls, then slash it whenever the protocol catches collusion or a clone-ring. An honest agent risks a sliver and keeps it; a sybil farm must freeze a separate forfeitable stake behind each of ten thousand clones — a glacier of locked capital — and watch slabs calve into the burn the instant one fake is unmasked. Faking a quorum stops being a free click and becomes pale ivory chips wagered on quartz-brittle identities that shatter under a single audit.
